name: WriteAccessAllowed

fields.name: from_request
fields.description: True, if the access was granted after the user accepted an explicit request from a Web App sent by the method requestWriteAccess

fields.name: web_app_name
fields.description: Name of the Web App, if the access was granted when the Web App was launched from a link

fields.name: from_attachment_menu
fields.description: True, if the access was granted when the bot was added to the attachment or side menu

fields.name: inviter
fields.description: The owner of the bot, if the access was granted when the owner invited the user to the private chat with the bot. Bot owners can invite up to 10 users at once by pressing the link https://t.me/botinvite/<bot_username>.

description: This object represents a service message about a user allowing a bot to write messages after adding it to the attachment menu, launching a Web App from a link, or accepting an explicit request from a Web App sent by the method requestWriteAccess, or about a user being invited to the private chat with the bot by the owner of the bot.
